first page of the text; no running head is printed on this page. Kanda/sukta taken from the printed body: the page opens '|| om ||' and carries the marginal sukta markers || 1 || and || 2 ||, with the catchword 'atharvaveda' and page number '1' at the foot. Faint text visible in the head margin is show-through from the verso.

printed running head reads '7 | 1-6' but the leaf itself carries only suktas 1-5: the marginal sukta markers on this page run || 1 || .. || 5 ||, and sukta 5 breaks off mid-sukta at the foot ('yajno babhuva sa a babhuva ...') to continue on n160. n160's head reads '7 | 5-9' and its body confirms it opens with sukta 5 mantra 2. The printed head on this leaf is therefore one sukta too high - the only such slip found in the book. header_literal records the head as printed; sukta_first/sukta_last record what the leaf actually carries.
